text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — Cloudcrest partner asked us to confirm Dedicated GPU entitlement in eu-west-IE (Ireland) by Thu. Need capacity, SKU mapping, and marketplace timeline.

Tom: Can you paste the exact units and fallback plan?

Aisha: They requested 40 A100-equivalent GPUs guaranteed, plus +20 burst on 5-day notice. Also 8 bare-metal edge nodes for BYO-network customers. Target public listing: 2025-07-01.

Diego: Ops note: we'll need kernel/driver matrix for A100 Gen2 and runtime compatibility for our int8/4-bit paths. I'll open a runtime ticket and request perf baselines.

deploy-bot: Created PARTNERS-4999 - Ireland launch checklist -> https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PARTNERS-4999

Nora-legal: For the marketplace co-announce, we need partner MSA excerpt and a KMS connectivity diagram. If you drop the draft by Mon EOD, legal can get a review to you by Wed.

Tom: Cloudcrest can also offer 20 T4-equivalents in europe-west1 (GCP) as a fallback region. Are we comfortable with mixed-pool behavior?

Diego: Mixed pools are fine if we gate SLAs to the Dedicated SKU only. Marketplace SKU should be best-effort and permit T4 fallback. We'll document gating in the entitlement matrix.

Aisha: Proposed product split: Dedicated-IE (SLA) = guaranteed 40 A100s; Marketplace-IE (BestEffort) = pooled T4s with A100 burst. I'll create SKU IDs and map entitlements in PARTNERS-4999.

Nora-legal: Partner requests 72h pre-announce review window for any joint quotes or quotes that include a partner quote. Also need partner marketing contact for quotes.

Aisha: Scheduling a 30m kickoff with Cloudcrest Tue 9am PT. Agenda: quotas & burst rules, SKU entitlements, legal checklist, launch roll cadence. I'll post the invite and attach an agenda.

Tom: Pinged Cloudcrest PM for quota confirmation and ETA on bare-metal readiness.

cloudcrest-bot: Cloudcrest update: initial allocation = 30 A100s available now, +20 burst available with 5-day notice; bare-metal nodes require 1-week lead time.

Aisha: Okay — plan B: launch with 30 guaranteed + burst policy. We'll reflect that in the PRD and SKU entitlement matrix. Thanks team, I'll update PARTNERS-4999 after the kickoff and tag owners: Diego (runtime), Tom (cloud quotas), Nora-legal (legal), Aisha (partner/mktg).
